author: Akien
prose: the divison is between the system device (host itself) and the cairn device (cairn "hardware layer" infrastructure). all the basic operational functionality is in those two and then everything else builds extentions to that functionality. the ground_loop, bus, rack, trouble panel, sleep-cycle token, circuit breakers — these are candidates to belong to the cairn device. trouble tickets / system alarms are owned by the cairn device. if the groundloop/bus/rack/whatever that make up the foundation aren't devices themselves, they're candidates to belong to the cairn device.
